payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses combinatorial formula with precomputed factorials and cumulative products to count subarrays with given sum, derived from lexicographic permutation sequence properties.
payload.rationale: The solution directly computes the answer using factorials and products derived from n, typical of combinatorial counting problems. It does not use DP states or recursion. This fits dp_counting_combinatorics as it involves counting via precomputed combinatorial numbers.
